vulnerability.name: CVE-2023-37788
vulnerability.description: goproxy: Denial of service (DoS) via unspecified vectors.

statements.impact_statement: Eventrouter does not depend on elazarl/goproxy: the package appears in neither go.mod nor go.sum, and eventrouter has no HTTP proxy functionality. Scanner matches occur via keyword matching on proxy-related metadata in the image, not a dependency relationship. Because the component is absent, eventrouter is not affected by any CVE in github.com/elazarl/goproxy; CVE-2023-37788 was flagged against eventrouter-rhel9 directly (LOG-4377) and is recorded here as the representative case. Confirmed absent from the manifests both before and after PR #69.
